userStories.title: Verify selected execution environment can perform a no-op repository-safe change
userStories.description: Perform a minimal non-destructive smoke validation of the selected Rorca execution environment. The runner should inspect the repository, create or update only a smoke evidence file under .rorca/smoke/, and run a lightweight validation command. Do not modify product code, secrets, deployment configuration, database migrations, or remote services.
acceptanceCriteria: The selected execution environment starts the configured agent without authentication or binary errors.
The agent writes a timestamped smoke evidence markdown file under .rorca/smoke/.
The evidence file records the environment name, agent name, current git branch, and validation command used.
No product source files, migrations, secrets, deployment files, or workspace configuration are changed.
A lightweight validation command such as git status --short completes successfully.
userStories.notes: Use this only after execution environment readiness and credentials are configured. This is the first gated smoke before real Hermes specs.
